title: Restore an editable project overview slide
instruction: Use the supplied reference to restore the damaged slide while preserving all unrelated content and native editability.

episodes.mutation: Reverse one connector and offset its endpoint from the target card.
acceptance: The connector points to the same card shown in the reference.
The line remains an editable connector.

preservation_contracts: Slide count and order remain unchanged.
Untargeted visible content remains semantically and visually stable.
